claims.statement: Ingestion accepts three input kinds over the draft and compile IPC channels handled in the main process: contract and blueprint are read deterministically without calling the configured model, text prefers the model when a generator is configured, and every result names the reader (contract, blueprint, text-rules or text-model) that produced the draft.

The model ingestion reader starts a session in a fresh temporary project with noTools 'all', assembles the reply from text deltas, rethrows a recorded agent error after the turn, bounds the call with a 120 second timeout, and removes the temporary directory it created.

The ingestion prompt encodes a seven-step reading discipline — split the document into business, domain and legal clauses, find the contract, split the pre-contract context, pair request spans with confirmation instants, read a breach as a new fulfillment pair, separate the thing into the domain context, and extract computed values as calculator or checker things — plus hard constraints against inventing facts, missing provenance, rewriting a legal clause into an obligation, more than two contract roles, using a span as a confirmation, and any output other than JSON.

When the configured model returns an unreadable reply or its call throws, readDraft falls back to the local text-rules reader, labels the result reader 'text-rules', and prepends an issue explaining the fallback instead of returning an empty draft.

A model reply is repaired when JSON arrives in a code fence or prose, when a collection is missing, when short evidence kind names are used, when an evidence kind is unrecognised (kept as other_evidence) or when a domainRole is outside the vocabulary (dropped), and each of those repairs is reported; a reply with no JSON, unparseable JSON or a collection whose items lack ids is refused with an error instead.

The blueprint reader accepts Markdown or CSV tables with stage, activity, evidence, kind, party, thing and system columns matched by alias containment, infers evidence kind and contract side from names, keeps duplicate document names as separate evidences, and reports an unconfirmed request instead of inventing a partner.

Compiling a draft re-keys ids uniquely, then computes writability as a monotone fixpoint over contexts, roles, things and evidences: dropping a contract transitively drops the context it rooted and that context's evidences, every removal is reported once, and the compiler never invents a missing role or root.

A fulfilment pair receives a completion rule only when both ends survived compilation and both live in the same contract context, otherwise the rule is skipped and the pair is reported; a confirmation that does not yet reference its request is connected by an explicit 1:1 `references` relationship instead of the pair being dropped or the fact being guessed.

compileDraft keeps the name the user typed, refuses to write when no entity survived, otherwise creates the project through the project store, returns compiler issues and a layout derived from the compiled model, and the IPC handler opens the editor on success.
补丁先应用再回结果，实际变更后记录 op/rationale、contexts/entities diff 与无 ghost overlay。

Revert calls session.undo only while the on-screen document is still identical to the patched document; after a later edit or patch the review closes without undoing, the revert button is not rendered, and the card tells the modeler to use the normal undo history, while accept always clears the review without touching the model.
测试覆盖编译的传递 drops、patch overlay 标记、保留、仅撤销最新补丁、后续编辑后不 undo 也不撤销，以及 EditorScreen 上 Escape 撤销与保留两条端到端路径。

Contract annotation files each sentence into exactly one bucket in a fixed order — risk allocation and procedure first, then a business action verb, then a computation — and reports rather than resolves an unclassifiable clause or a clause that is both procedural and obligatory.

The contract reader feeds only the business clauses to the offline row reader, turns computing clauses into calculator or checker things rooted in a domain context it writes itself, deduplicates them by label so one noun yields one component, keeps each clause as the component's provenance, and reports a formula it cannot name instead of inventing a calculator.

IngestionDraft is the single half-way shape every reader writes — a manifest name, a source and eight arrays of elements with provisional ids and optional provenance — and isIngestionDraftShape guards the non-empty model name plus those containers' element ids only, so a draft with a wrong optional field still reaches the review panel.

The draft review panel shows which reader produced the draft, the evidence, pair and participant counts, broken-pair count, the clause split with filtered legal sentences, and the reader's gaps; a person may rename an evidence, change its kind or remove it, while the contract's role pair is not editable, and nothing is compiled or written until the person picks a target and submits.
renderer 再解析请求、一次 applyPatchBatch，共用人类历史，不再 CommandSequence。
undo 应用 Immer inverse patches；review 只在当前与 after 同引用时 undo，否则保留后续工作只关闭。

Escape and Mod+Enter belong to a pending patch review only while one exists, because the editor's window-level shortcut table adds acceptPatch and revertPatch only then; Escape reverts ahead of the typing guard and Mod+Enter accepts after it, and the inline copilot's capture-phase Escape stands down while a patch is pending so the revert wins.

The editor screen owns the single usePatchReview controller and hands the same review to both the agent rail (AgentCopilot) and the inline copilot, so one applied patch has one review card; the review's overlay is passed to the canvas and the copilot rail badge lights while a review is pending.

A batch that only runs `test` or changes nothing still answers success:true with the op names, yet records no undo entry because Immer produced no patches and opens no review card because before and after are the same reference, while any rejected batch answers success:false with the error and leaves the document untouched.

The offline text reader recognises a fixed Chinese business vocabulary — agreement words, deadlines, completion verbs, proof documents, parties and things — reads a deadline clause as a request and a result-only clause as its confirmation, treats a breach clause as another obligation rather than a rollback, signs at most one contract per text unless a clause names another agreement, and reports unpaired requests and unpaired confirmations instead of inventing the other end.

Ingestion in the desktop app is main-only: the renderer reaches it through the preload `ingestion.draft/compile` invokes with no fs or model access, and main always registers the channels with `createModelIngestionReader()`, so a prose import always tries the model first and the local reader is only the failure path.

compileIngestionDraft writes one completion rule per fulfilment pair and never reads `draft.breachCompensations`, so the trigger-to-compensation link the readers assemble survives only in the draft: it becomes neither a rule nor a `breach_compensation` relationship, and it is not reported in `droppedIds`.
